These are warning signs of a stroke (FAST signs: face drooping, arm weakness, speech difficulty, time to call). Call 911 immediately and do not let her sleep it off. Note the time the symptoms started, because stroke treatment is time-sensitive and every minute counts. Stay with her and don't give her anything to eat or drink.

Use her epinephrine auto-injector right now, in the outer thigh: this looks like anaphylaxis. Then call 911 (or the local emergency number) immediately, even if she starts to feel better, because symptoms can come back. Help her lie down with her legs raised, or let her sit up if breathing is easier. If she does not improve and a second auto-injector is available, the dispatcher may tell you to use it.
